newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Esprit Asia in HK$616 mln new shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Esprit Asia in HK$616 mln new shr issue.

text.p: Esprit Asia Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to issue 180.41 million new shares to its parent Worldwide Thousand Ltd (WTL), raising net proceeds of HK$616 million.

WTL, which currently holds a 71.14 percent stake in Esprit Asia, also agreed to place 180.41 million existing shares with professional and institutional investors at HK$3.50 per share, the company said in a statement.
The placing price represents a discount of about 4.1 percent to Monday's close of HK$3.65 per share.
After the transactions, WTL's Esprit Asia stake would be diluted to about 59.29 percent of the enlarged share capital.
The proceeds of the new share issue would be used to reduce the group's bank loans and for general working capital, Esprit Asia said.
Esprit Asia said if the new shares were issued ex-dividend, the net proceeds would be about HK$609 million.
The company declared an interim dividend of 3.65 H.K. cents per share for the six months ended December 31, 1996.
